supplier.locator: Theorem1, normalization and uniformity proof; accepted scope pinned separately

assertion.statement: Replace the original polynomial nilsequence by an exactly equal sequence on fixed taut geometry, with h(0)=1 and a boundedly translated test function.
assertion.objects: G0=G1 after restriction, g0=q gamma, h=q^-1 g gamma^-1, F_q(x)=F(qx).
assertion.hypotheses: Rational finite degree filtration; bounded Lipschitz complex test function; q from one fixed compact representative set.
assertion.quantifiers: Every adapted polynomial g and every such F.
assertion.parameter_range: Fixed s>=1; all integer inputs and arbitrary polynomial coefficients.
assertion.uniformity: Geometry and metric constants fixed independently of g and N.
assertion.constants: Lip(F_q) at most a fixed geometric multiple of Lip(F); norm bound unchanged.
assertion.normalizations: Exact value identity and exact lattice intersections; no quotient of the original function by a scalar.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Trivial positive groups and constant sequences are permitted; actual support may shrink but not enlarge.
assertion.limit_order: Fix original filtered data, choose bounded q, then use the increment construction.

assertion.statement: The groups P_i=poly(Z->G_{bullet+i}) form a filtered group; P1 is normal in P0.
assertion.objects: Shifted filtrations G_(j+i), left and right increments, pointwise polynomial group operation.
assertion.hypotheses: Every shifted filtration has nesting and [G_(a+i),G_(b+j)] subset G_(a+b+i+j); degree finite.
assertion.quantifiers: All i,j>=0 and all polynomial maps in the stated groups.
assertion.parameter_range: Integer domain with degree filtration; no tautness required for a shifted target.
assertion.uniformity: Algebraic identities independent of coefficients and interval length.
assertion.normalizations: Left difference is h(t+1)h(t)^-1; normality converts it to h(t)^-1h(t+1).
assertion.exceptional_cases: P_i is trivial for i>s; index zero is included.
assertion.limit_order: Verify the shifted target axioms before applying B.4/B.6; do not assume the target GI.

assertion.objects: P_i, Taylor factors u_j^(binom(t,j)), V_i, pointwise exponential and BCH.
assertion.hypotheses: Connected simply connected nilpotent group, closed filtration subgroups and finite degree s.
assertion.quantifiers: Every i and every polynomial in P_i or Lie polynomial in V_i.
assertion.parameter_range: 0<=i<=s, arbitrary real coefficients; all integer inputs.
assertion.uniformity: Coordinate spaces and changes depend only on fixed filtration.
assertion.constants: At most s-i+1 Taylor coefficients; BCH terminates.
assertion.normalizations: Binomial and monomial bases are compared through BCH, retaining the weight j+i.
assertion.exceptional_cases: i=0 is used only to identify h and its normal subgroup; the suspension uses i=1.
assertion.limit_order: Construct P_i/V_i before defining the smooth real-clock action.

assertion.objects: K=P1/Lambda1 embedded in the clock fiber, pi(p)=p(0)Gamma, b_n(t)=h(t)^-1h(t+n).
assertion.hypotheses: h(0)=1; b in P1 by normality; integer clock elements lie in the lattice.
assertion.quantifiers: Every normalized h and every integer n, positive, zero or negative.

assertion.objects: F_q composed pi on K, McShane real/imaginary extensions, unit-disk metric projection, finite collection of lifted nilmanifolds.
assertion.hypotheses: Each polynomial supplier manifold is fixed; F is1-bounded with fixed Lipschitz bound; target correlation bound is positive and fixed.
